sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports calendar views and store
sections.what: Brings in icons, the store, the time block grid, the agenda list and the evening review pop-up.
sections.why: Likely reason: this screen only arranges other pieces, so it imports them.

sections.name: CalendarView (part 1)
sections.title: Header, date and grid tab
sections.what: Shows the heading, today's date, a short description and the button that opens the evening review. Also shows the tab button for the timeblock grid.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the date and main controls at the top, where the user always sees them.
sections.watch_out: The date is set when the screen draws, so it can be out of date if the page stays open past midnight.

sections.name: CalendarView (part 2)
sections.title: Agenda tab and view switch
sections.what: Shows the tab button for the upcoming agenda. Shows the timeblock grid when that tab is active, otherwise shows the agenda. The evening review pop-up is included but stays closed until opened.
sections.why: Likely reason: a simple switch between two views. Reason the review is always included is not stated.
sections.watch_out: This file passes every calendar event to the grid, so any limit to today must happen inside the grid.

summary: The calendar screen that switches between a time block grid and an upcoming agenda, and opens the evening review.
purpose: Gives one place to plan the day's time blocks and see upcoming items.
why: Likely reason: the schedule grid and the agenda are two views of the same plans, so they sit under one screen. Reason not stated.
how: Reads calendar events from the store. Shows a heading with today's date and a short description. Holds which tab is active and whether the evening review is open. Clicking a tab shows either the grid or the agenda. The review opens as a pop-up on top of the page.
inputs: calendarEvents from the store. The tab and review choices made by the user.
outputs: The displayed view. Changing tabs or opening the review does not save data by itself.
risks: The date is calculated when the screen draws, so it can stay out of date if the app stays open past midnight until the screen redraws. All calendar events are passed to the grid, and whether they are filtered to today is not visible here.
debug: If the wrong day shows, check when the screen last redrew and the device's clock. If the grid shows events from other days, check TimeBlockGrid, since this file passes everything in. If the agenda is empty, check UpcomingEventsView.
